generator: pyfcirt.simulate prior predictive, one shared draw at N=500
truth_format: xarray Dataset.to_dict(data=list), native parameters and deterministic variables
nested_cohorts: first 50 and 100 person labels from the 500-person draw; identical responses and item parameters
design_adaptations: String IDs and theta trait names set before simulation; the measurement model is declared on the design. Unused location-side fields are omitted for dominance models.
